data.current_description: Issues a personal test key (`mv_test_…`) for a work e-mail address, protected by a Cloudflare Turnstile token from the form at https://mobilevalidate.com/get-test-key. The key works in test mode with any number (never billed, never reaches a data source), including bulk jobs and test-mode webhooks. It is shown **once** and never returned again. Each address can receive at most 3 test keys in 30 days; after that the answer is 409 test_key_exists. At most 3 requests per network per day, whatever their result (IPv6 networks count per /64). The request also asks for live access, which we review by hand. No authentication.
data.summary_suggestion: Issue a personal test API key
data.description_suggestion: Issues a personal test key (`mv_test_…`) for a work e-mail address, protected by a Cloudflare Turnstile token. The test key enables testing with any phone number or e-mail address in test mode without billing or reaching production data sources, including bulk jobs and webhooks. **Important:** The key is displayed only once in the response and cannot be retrieved again. Rate limits: maximum 3 test keys per e-mail address per 30 days (returns 409 test_key_exists if exceeded), and 3 requests per network per day. The request also initiates a manual review for live access. No authentication required.

The description is comprehensive and clear about inputs, outputs, waiting behavior, and limitations. Improved summary emphasizes real-time checks and clarifies the action.

data.current_summary: Check up to 100 numbers and e-mail addresses
data.current_description: Runs every requested check (see GET /v1/services) for every identifier of the check's input type: phone checks for `numbers`, e-mail checks for `emails`. Result rows come back in order: numbers first, then e-mails. The call waits up to `wait` seconds (default 10) for all answers; if some are still running it answers `202` with `status: pending` and a `next.poll_url` (or use a webhook). Checks without real-time support are refused with 403 service_disabled (param `checks[i]`) — send them in a bulk job. E-mail checks answer only whether an account or mailbox exists — never names, photos or profiles.

The description is comprehensive and clear about inputs, outputs, waiting behavior, and limitations. Improved summary emphasizes real-time checks and clarifies the action.

data.current_description: Issues a personal test key (`mv_test_…`) for a work e-mail address, protected by a Cloudflare Turnstile token from the form at https://mobilevalidate.com/get-test-key. The key works in test mode with any number (never billed, never reaches a data source), including bulk jobs and test-mode webhooks. It is shown **once** and never returned again. Each address can receive at most 3 test keys in 30 days; after that the answer is 409 test_key_exists. At most 3 requests per network per day, whatever their result (IPv6 networks count per /64). The request also asks for live access, which we review by hand. No authentication.
data.summary_suggestion: Issue a personal test API key
data.description_suggestion: Issues a personal test key (`mv_test_…`) for a work e-mail address, protected by a Cloudflare Turnstile token. The test key enables testing with any phone number or e-mail address in test mode without billing or reaching production data sources, including bulk jobs and webhooks. **Important:** The key is displayed only once in the response and cannot be retrieved again. Rate limits: maximum 3 test keys per e-mail address per 30 days (returns 409 test_key_exists if exceeded), and 3 requests per network per day. The request also initiates a manual review for live access. No authentication required.
data.reasoning: Summary was too generic ('Get' is passive). Description is comprehensive but poorly structured for AI agent parsing. Improved summary uses active verb 'Issue'. Reorganized description with clear sections: what it does, capabilities, critical retrieval behavior, rate limits, and access review process. data.current_summary: Download a job's results as CSV or NDJSON
data.current_description: Streams the whole result file, one line per row (numbers, then e-mails) in input order. CSV columns: row_no, input_masked, e164, country, number_status, service, status, registered, business, checked_at, cached, billed (for the row's primary check = first requested check of its kind), then kind, email, email_status, then per service `<service>.status`, `<service>.registered`, `<service>.<attribute>`, `<service>.billed` (empty for rows of the other kind). NDJSON lines have the same shape as result items.
data.description_suggestion: Streams the completed job's results as CSV or NDJSON format. Results are ordered by input row sequence (phone numbers first, then e-mail addresses). CSV includes columns for identifiers (row_no, input_masked, e164, country, number_status), check results (service, status, registered, business, checked_at, cached, billed), and per-service attributes. NDJSON format returns one result item per line with identical structure. Requires the job to be in completed state. Supports format selection via query parameter.
